reason: The submitted model is sufficiently established. The orthorhombic cell is decisively indexed (all 52 detected lines, mean position error about 0.0013 degrees and maximum below 0.007 degrees), and the trace progressed beyond peak matching to intensity and all-profile refinement. A less-constrained C-centered positional search converged onto the Amm2 mirror-layer framework, while the higher-symmetry Cmmm realization gave systematic intensity mismatches. The final Amm2 refinement was stable from independent starts; its polar-axis-reversed solution is crystallographically equivalent rather than a distinct survivor. An independent whole-profile check gives approximately 9.1% Rwp for the submitted ordering, and fixed-framework Mg/Yb swaps are materially worse (approximately 11.4-18.4%); thus the light-element site is diffraction-supported despite the unavailable supplied comparable-Rwp report. The CIF has the correct Yb5Mg reduced composition with Z=2, full occupancies, a plausible density, and a chemically reasonable minimum separation of about 3.59 angstrom. No materially different, physically plausible structure remains likely to improve the candidate set enough to warrant another attempt.
